title: YourMondayMotivator: Much to learn
html:
It's another Monday morning after a wedding for me. This time it wasn't mine, it was a friends. A fantastic time, completely different to my own wedding last week.

Last week I only mentioned our wedding in passing and wrote about how posture affects your attitude. How much have I to learn.

The furore about not writing screeds about our wedding was very interesting because I always write what I am thinking about on the Monday morning. I was worn out and it turns out ill. After an amazing weekend I had to take a few days off work. Definitely a first for me because I am always fit and healthy.

It seems readers feel a certain ownership over the MondayMotivator which is amazing to me. I write the MondayMotivator because it helps me learn about lots of different things. I read things, I discuss them, I think about them and then I write about it and my experience and learn. Last week was a great learning experience for me and hopefully I have passed my experience on to you today.

There is a Chinese Proverb that goes, "Learning is like rowing upstream: not to advance is to drop back."

I'm going to keep rowing. I recommend you do the same.

Have a great week.

Glenn

P.S. If you are interested in my wedding I have put some shotshere. My bride is very beautiful. I am a very lucky man.
